justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/function/IOSupplier.java (66 lines). It is a @FunctionalInterface with exactly one abstract method, T get(), plus only two small default convenience methods, asSupplier() and getUnchecked(); there are no fields, nested types, or additional responsibilities. The companion src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/function/IOSupplierTest.java only exercises those three methods, which is consistent with a small single-purpose interface rather than insufficient modularization.
